Title: Menopause Joint Pain - Habits That Ease Stiff Knees

Description:
Estrogen protects cartilage and calms joint inflammation - once it drops after menopause, more than half of women develop joint pain, and those who never used hormone therapy show nearly triple the risk of osteoarthritis.

The muscles around your joints, your weight, and omega-3s all make a real difference. Build light strength training, keep weight off your knees with low-impact cardio, and add fatty fish or an omega-3 supplement.
